policy: A vendored producer contract may be pinned to an unmerged producer branch only while it is listed here. The entry names the exact producer branch and commit, the producer-published contract digest, an owner, a migration back to a trusted main lock, and an expiry. Nothing here claims that the pinned commit is merged, released, or deployed.
